parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposure is high. Same-sex conduct is criminalised and enforced, with imprisonment up to 14 years documented (one 15-year sentence). Police are a documented source of harm: bribe solicitation after arrests, threats of other charges to extort payment, and forced anal examinations used as evidence, which a 2016 report found amounts to torture or degrading treatment. A 2022 presidential statement produced a documented spike in hate speech and assaults. Official protection is absent, and mob violence involved police. The dossier has no trans-specific entry, document, facility or custody rules, and no trans-specific violence rate. I extrapolated the risk from the enforced sexuality regime and police practice, which a trans visitor presenting as gender-nonconforming could plausibly trigger. Dated mob incidents and organised opposition add to the hostility. I kept the score above the severe tier because no execution or trans-specific sweeps are documented.
